1.w: And YHWH appeared to him by the Oaks of Mamre, and he was sitting in the entrance of the tent in the heat of the day.

2.w: And he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, three men were standing by him. And he saw [them], and he ran to meet them from the entrance of the tent, and he bowed himself to the earth.

3.w: And he said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your eyes, please, do not pass on by Your servant.

4.w: Please let a little water be brought, and wash your⁺ feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.

5.w: And I will bring a morsel of bread, that you may refresh your⁺ hearts; afterward, you⁺ may pass on, for upon thus you⁺ have come to your⁺ servant.” And they said, “Yes, you may do as you have said.”

6.w: And Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah and said, “Quickly [take] three seahs of fine meal, knead [it], and make cakes.”

7.w: And Abraham ran to the herd, and he took a tender and good son of the herd and gave [it] to the young man, and he hurried to prepare it.

8.w: And he took butter and milk and the son of the herd that he had prepared, and he set [it] before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they ate.

9.w: And they said to him, “Where [is] Sarah your wife?” And he said, “Behold, in the tent.”

10.w: And He said, “I will surely return to you according to the time of life; and behold—a son to Sarah, your wife.” And Sarah was listening at the entrance to the tent, and it [was] behind him.

11.w: And Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in years; it had ceased to be for Sarah the way of women.

12.w: And Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I am worn out, shall there be to me pleasure? And my lord is old!”

13.w: And YHWH said to Abraham, “Why did this one, Sarah, laugh, saying, ‘Shall I truly bear [a child] when I am old?’

14.w: Is any word is too difficult for YHWH? At the appointed time I will return to you, according to the time of life, and unto Sarah [will be] a son.”

15.w: And Sarah denied [it], saying, “I did not laugh,” for she was afraid. And He said, “No, but you did laugh.”

16.w: And the men rose from there and looked on the face of Sodom, and Abraham walked with them to send them off.

17.w: And YHWH said, “Shall I hide from Abraham what I am doing?

18.w: And Abraham will surely become a nation great and mighty, and in him all the nations of the earth shall be blessed.

19.w: For I have known him in order that he may command his children and his house after him that they keep the way of YHWH by doing what is right and just, that YHWH may bring to Abraham what He has spoken to him.”

20.w: And YHWH said, “Because the outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great and because their sin is very grievous,

21.w: I will go down now and see whether the outcry against it that has come to Me they have done completely—and if not, I will know.”

22.w: And the men turned away from there and went toward Sodom, and Abraham still stood before YHWH.

23.w: And Abraham came near and said, “Would You also destroy the righteous with the wicked?

24.w: Suppose there are fifty righteous in the midst of the city; would You also destroy and not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous who [are] within it?

25.w: Far be it from You to do such a thing as this, to slay the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be as the wicked. Far be it from You! Shall the Judge of all the earth not do justice?”

26.w: And YHWH said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous in the midst of the city, then I will spare the whole place on their account.”

27.w: And Abraham answered and said, “Behold, please, I have taken it upon myself to speak to the Lord, and I [am] dust and ash.

28.w: Suppose there are lacking five of the fifty righteous? Would You destroy for the five the whole city?” And He said, “I will not destroy [it] if I find there forty and five.”

29.w: And he added again to speak to Him, and he said, “Suppose there should be found there forty?” And He said, “I will not do [it] on account of the forty.”

30.w: And he said, “Please, may the Lord not be hot, and I will speak. Suppose there should be found thirty.” And He said, “I will not do [it] if I find there thirty.”

31.w: And he said, “Behold, please, I have ventured to speak to the Lord. Suppose there should be found twenty.” And He said, “I will not destroy [it] on account of the twenty.”

32.w: And he said, “Please may the Lord not be hot, and I will speak but once more. Suppose there should be found ten.” And He said, “I will not destroy [it] on account of the ten.”

33.w: And YHWH went His way as soon as He had finished speaking with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.
